# Addition and subtraction (IEEE 754-2008 clause 5.4.1). Derived from
# "Exponent of a result", "Sign of a result", "Overflow", "Underflow and
# subnormal results" and "NaN and infinity operands" in the package
# documentation. The preferred exponent is min(Q(x), Q(y)).

# --- Add64 ---

# exact: the preferred exponent, or the cohort member nearest it
Add64 even exact 1.0 2.00 -> 3.00
Add64 even exact 12 7.00 -> 19.00
Add64 even exact 1E+2 1E+4 -> 1.01E+4
Add64 even exact 1E+5 1 -> 100001
Add64 even exact 0.5 0.5 -> 1.0
Add64 even exact -1.5 2.25 -> 0.75
Add64 even exact 123.456 -123.4 -> 0.056
Add64 even exact 1E+369 1E+369 -> 2E+369
Add64 even exact 1E+16 0 -> 1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 even exact 9999999999999999 -9999999999999998 -> 1
Add64 even exact 123456789012345 1E-1 -> 123456789012345.1
Add64 zero exact 123456789012345 -1E-1 -> 123456789012344.9
Add64 even exact 1E-383 -1E-398 -> 9.99999999999999E-384

# inexact: a non-tie fraction is discarded; the result has 16 digits
Add64 even inexact 1E+16 1 -> 1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 away inexact 1E+16 1 -> 1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 zero inexact 1E+16 1 -> 1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 up inexact 1E+16 1 -> 1.000000000000001E+16
Add64 down inexact 1E+16 1 -> 1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 even inexact 1E+16 16 -> 1.000000000000002E+16
Add64 zero inexact 1E+16 16 -> 1.000000000000001E+16
Add64 even inexact -1E+16 -1 -> -1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 up inexact -1E+16 -1 -> -1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 down inexact -1E+16 -1 -> -1.000000000000001E+16
Add64 zero inexact -1E+16 -1 -> -1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 even inexact 1 1E-20 -> 1.000000000000000
Add64 up inexact 1 1E-20 -> 1.000000000000001
Add64 down inexact 1 1E-20 -> 1.000000000000000
Add64 even inexact 9999999999999999 0.4 -> 9999999999999999
Add64 even inexact 1.0E+370 1 -> 1.000000000000000E+370
Add64 even inexact 1234567890123456 0.7 -> 1234567890123457
Add64 even inexact 1234567890123456 1E-5 -> 1234567890123456
Add64 up inexact 1234567890123456 1E-5 -> 1234567890123457
Add64 down inexact 1234567890123456 0.7 -> 1234567890123456

# tie: exactly halfway, under all five modes
Add64 even tie 1E+16 5 -> 1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 away tie 1E+16 5 -> 1.000000000000001E+16
Add64 zero tie 1E+16 5 -> 1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 up tie 1E+16 5 -> 1.000000000000001E+16
Add64 down tie 1E+16 5 -> 1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 even tie -1E+16 -5 -> -1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 away tie -1E+16 -5 -> -1.000000000000001E+16
Add64 zero tie -1E+16 -5 -> -1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 up tie -1E+16 -5 -> -1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 down tie -1E+16 -5 -> -1.000000000000001E+16
Add64 even tie 1E+16 15 -> 1.000000000000002E+16
Add64 even tie 1E+16 25 -> 1.000000000000002E+16
Add64 away tie 1E+16 25 -> 1.000000000000003E+16
# a Mode outside the five behaves as ToNearestEven
Add64 7 tie 1E+16 5 -> 1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 255 tie 1E+16 25 -> 1.000000000000002E+16

# carry: rounding carries into a new digit and raises the exponent
Add64 even carry 9999999999999999 1 -> 1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 even carry 9999999999999999 0.5 -> 1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 up carry 9999999999999999 0.4 -> 1.000000000000000E+16
Add64 zero carry 9999999999999999 0.4 -> 9999999999999999
Add64 up carry 999.9999999999999 1E-14 -> 1000.000000000000
Add64 even carry 999.9999999999999 1E-14 -> 999.9999999999999
Add64 even carry 0.9999999999999999 1E-16 -> 1.000000000000000
Add64 even carry -9999999999999999 -1 -> -1.000000000000000E+16

# overflow: decided after rounding, by mode and sign
Add64 even overflow 9.999999999999999E+384 1E+369 -> Infinity
Add64 away overflow 9.999999999999999E+384 1E+369 -> Infinity
Add64 zero overflow 9.999999999999999E+384 1E+369 -> 9.999999999999999E+384
Add64 up overflow 9.999999999999999E+384 1E+369 -> Infinity
Add64 down overflow 9.999999999999999E+384 1E+369 -> 9.999999999999999E+384
Add64 even overflow -9.999999999999999E+384 -1E+369 -> -Infinity
Add64 away overflow -9.999999999999999E+384 -1E+369 -> -Infinity
Add64 zero overflow -9.999999999999999E+384 -1E+369 -> -9.999999999999999E+384
Add64 up overflow -9.999999999999999E+384 -1E+369 -> -9.999999999999999E+384
Add64 down overflow -9.999999999999999E+384 -1E+369 -> -Infinity
Add64 even overflow 9.999999999999999E+384 1E+368 -> 9.999999999999999E+384
Add64 up overflow 9.999999999999999E+384 1E+368 -> Infinity
Add64 even overflow 9.999999999999999E+384 5E+368 -> Infinity
Add64 zero overflow 9.999999999999999E+384 5E+368 -> 9.999999999999999E+384
Add64 even overflow 1.000000000000000E+384 9.000000000000000E+384 -> Infinity
Add64 zero overflow 1.000000000000000E+384 9.000000000000000E+384 -> 9.999999999999999E+384
Add64 even overflow 9.999999999999999E+384 9.999999999999999E+384 -> Infinity

# underflow: the subnormal edge (sums at MinExp are always exact)
Add64 even underflow 1E-398 1E-398 -> 2E-398
Add64 even underflow 9.99999999999999E-384 1E-398 -> 1.000000000000000E-383
Add64 even underflow 1E-398 -2E-398 -> -1E-398
Add64 down underflow 5E-398 4E-398 -> 9E-398
Add64 even underflow 1.000000000000000E-383 -1E-398 -> 9.99999999999999E-384

# clamp: results at the exponent bounds
Add64 even clamp 1.0E+370 1.0E+370 -> 2.0E+370
Add64 even clamp 1E+369 9E+369 -> 1.0E+370
Add64 even clamp 0E+369 0E+369 -> 0E+369
Add64 down clamp 0E+369 -0E+369 -> -0E+369
Add64 even clamp 9E+369 9E+369 -> 1.8E+370
Add64 even clamp 0E-398 -0E-398 -> 0E-398

# zero: the sign of an exact zero sum
Add64 even zero 1 -1 -> 0
Add64 away zero 1 -1 -> 0
Add64 zero zero 1 -1 -> 0
Add64 up zero 1 -1 -> 0
Add64 down zero 1 -1 -> -0
Add64 down zero -1 1 -> -0
Add64 even zero 1.00 -1 -> 0.00
Add64 down zero 1E+3 -1E+3 -> -0E+3
Add64 even zero 0 -0 -> 0
Add64 down zero 0 -0 -> -0
Add64 even zero -0 0 -> 0
Add64 down zero -0 0 -> -0
Add64 even zero 0 0 -> 0
Add64 down zero 0 0 -> 0
Add64 even zero -0 -0 -> -0
Add64 up zero -0 -0 -> -0
Add64 even zero 1E-398 -1E-398 -> 0E-398
Add64 down zero 1E-398 -1E-398 -> -0E-398
Add64 even zero 0E+5 0E+3 -> 0E+3
Add64 even zero -0E+5 -0E+3 -> -0E+3
Add64 even zero 0 1.50 -> 1.50
Add64 even zero -0 -1.50 -> -1.50
Add64 even zero 0E+5 1.50 -> 1.50

# inf
Add64 even inf Infinity -Infinity -> NaN
Add64 even inf -Infinity Infinity -> NaN
Add64 even inf Infinity Infinity -> Infinity
Add64 even inf -Infinity -Infinity -> -Infinity
Add64 even inf Infinity -9.999999999999999E+384 -> Infinity
Add64 even inf -Infinity 9.999999999999999E+384 -> -Infinity
Add64 down inf 1 Infinity -> Infinity
Add64 even inf Infinity 0 -> Infinity
Add64 even inf -0 -Infinity -> -Infinity

# nan: every NaN operand gives the canonical quiet NaN
Add64 even nan 1 NaN -> NaN
Add64 even nan NaN Infinity -> NaN
Add64 even nan sNaN 1 -> NaN
Add64 even nan -NaN 1 -> NaN
Add64 even nan 1 -sNaN -> NaN
Add64 even nan NaN NaN -> NaN
Add64 even nan 0x7c00000000000001 1 -> NaN
Add64 even nan 1 0xfe0000000001e240 -> NaN
Add64 even nan 0x7c038d7ea4c68000 1 -> NaN

# noncanon: a coefficient field above 10^16-1 reads as zero
Add64 even noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff 1 -> 1
Add64 even noncanon 1 0x6c7386f26fc10000 -> 1
Add64 even noncanon 0xec9fffffffffffff 0E+3 -> 0E+3
Add64 even noncanon 0xec9fffffffffffff -0E+2 -> -0E+2
Add64 down noncanon 0xec9fffffffffffff 0E+7 -> -0E+5
Add64 even noncanon 0x6007ffffffffffff 1E-398 -> 1E-398
Add64 even noncanon 0x77ffffffffffffff 2.5 -> 2.5
